scheme_name: Award of Post-Matric Scholarship to Scheduled Caste Students
other_conditions: The applicant must be a resident of the Union Territory of Puducherry for at least 5 years.
The applicant must be a student studying at the Post‑Matric level or Post‑Secondary stage.
benefits_summary: Fee fixed by the Fee Committee is reimbursed, and a maintenance allowance is provided to hostellers or day scholars.
